title: Retire legacy deploy roles, budget stack and lab IAM user
description:
Part of story chatticus-e50451 (group G6). Legacy ChatticusGitHubDeploy (three roles), ChatticusBudgets (50 USD account budget and email topic), and the lab IAM user that still has two active access keys (last used 2026-09-08; hard control forbids standing IAM keys). Owner or workflow logs confirm every GitHub environment assumes the Chatticus-account roles first. Deactivate keys, wait 7 days, delete keys and user.

Feature: Standing credentials removed
  Scenario: No Chatticus IAM user or key remains
    Given the keys were deactivated for 7 days
    When the user and keys are deleted
    Then deploys still succeed with OIDC roles in the Chatticus account
